title: Definite Articles: el, la, los, las

blocks.markdown: Spanish nouns have two genders — masculine and feminine — each with a singular and plural article: **el** (masc. singular), **la** (fem. singular), **los** (masc. plural), **las** (fem. plural). Most nouns ending in **-o** are masculine and most ending in **-a** are feminine, though there are exceptions worth learning individually.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct article for "pan" (bread — masculine: el pan).
Choose the correct article for "ciudad" (city — feminine: la ciudad).
___ amigos son simpáticos. (friends — masculine plural: los amigos)
